(a) Its -0.271 pp microns delta is an ARTIFACT OF POOLING truncated runs with clean ones; the 2 runs that completed the pipeline are +0.00534396 pp OVER the champion, above the 0.002 bar. H64 on microns is UNMEASURED, not negative. (b) Its 'the box degrades under sustained load' diagnosis is WRONG: 10 connectome arms over 3.8 h showed no monotone wall trend, and the microns re-runs were alone on the GPU and truncated with DECREASING walls. The cause is a ~1% RUNTIME MARGIN (3397.8-3418.0 s against a 3450 s deadline). Corollary: the paired design does NOT cancel for a NON-NESTED pair (paired sd 0.021196 > comparator sd 0.019124). Filed as P21 and P22. Also closed P20 (state prose 22,160 -> ~10k).

_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
